audit: Independent G integration audit of owned noun gender on source-linked candidates
scope: Narrow linked_dictionary v2 integration of separately audited same-entry noun metadata; no deployment or approval of unrelated existing behavior
checks: Diff against frozen F contains the version increment, source-only noun metadata retrieval, full metadata-packet replay, optional missing-gender application and explicit provenance view. Target retrieval and sense extraction are unchanged.

Metadata is fetched only for source anchor entry IDs with literal source POS noun. Supplied metadata must reproduce exactly from its complete claims and hash-bound source wrapper; entry identity, source headword and noun POS must match the candidate source.

Gender is added only for single_source_gender when the source form's normalized features do not already supply gender. It is copied through an explicit schema-label mapping; case, number and other features remain source-anchor values.

27 queries compared against frozen F produce the same 126 source/target/anchor paths. All existing linked-path fields and all sense payloads are identical after removing the new metadata view; feature differences are exclusively the 20 independently source-verified missing-gender additions.

Every metadata source_record_proof equals the headword proof returned by the audited noun helper for that exact source entry. Metadata views retain evidence-group locators, literal source tags, scope, claim IDs, status, application basis and contextually_selected=false.
Actual λαγῴα paths preserve explicit feminine gender despite the source noun's conflicting paradigm metadata. Actual παισί paths retain masculine/feminine entry alternatives without adding a gender.

Target-entry metadata mapped under a source key, tampered metadata output, and altered public parent-hash proof are rejected. Public validated_candidates rebuilds local expected inventory, rather than trusting the supplied digest.
Distinct δῆμος etymologies remain separate target entries. παχύς masculine/neuter adjective candidates and the distinct πάχος noun candidate remain available.
No contextual selection or paid provider request is added. Source cache stamps and the new version distinguish inventories; returned cached inventories are deep copies.
python -m pytest tests/test_linked_dictionary.py tests/test_noun_entry_features.py tests/test_interlinear.py tests/test_sense_ranker.py -q: 98 passed.
limitations: Candidate gender enrichment does not assert that this source-linked candidate is the correct analysis of a particular occurrence. Link aliases remain distinct from exact printed-surface attestation.
Source noun metadata must never be borrowed from a target meaning entry or used to override explicit source form gender.
Counts describe candidate paths, not newly verified passage readings or independent dictionary senses.
Compact metadata is a transport view, not a standalone cryptographic authority. Public consumers must retain the local rebuild-and-equality validation boundary.

Future source snapshots containing multiple explicit form genders without a unique normalized Gender require continued preservation of ambiguity; no general permission to infer missing morphology is granted.
mutations: Only this new audit report was written by auditor. E/F snapshots, previous reports, source databases, ranker code and deployment were not modified.
